_comment: Which upstream commands have an equivalent here. Every command must appear, with exactly one of 'action' (the sw-action.py action that covers it) or 'gap' (why it does not). scripts/inventory.py fails when upstream adds one that is missing here; scripts/test-sw-action.py fails when an action named here does not exist, or when the README counts disagree.

shopware.createSnippetFromSelection.gap: worth adding; needs the selection plus a snippet-file picker

shopware.insertSnippet.gap: worth adding; needs a picker over existing snippets

shopware.symfony.browseDoctrineEntities.gap: returns nothing for Shopware, which uses the DAL rather than Doctrine

shopware.symfony.runConsoleCommandPicker.gap: a task runs bin/console directly; only the picker is missing

shopwareLSP.restart.gap: Zed's own `language server: restart` covers it

shopware.admin.extendComponent.gap: picker-then-insert over Vue components, no equivalent yet

shopware.admin.overrideMethod.gap: picker-then-insert over Vue components, no equivalent yet

shopware.copySnippetUsage.gap: clipboard-only convenience; no clipboard access from a task

shopware.createAdminSnippetFromSelection.gap: worth adding; needs the selection plus a snippet-file picker

shopware.createEventListener.gap: worth adding; the server command exists

shopware.createSnippetFromSelection.gap: worth adding; needs the selection plus a snippet-file picker

shopware.editor.insertSnippetAtPosition.gap: worth adding; needs a picker over existing snippets

shopware.insertSnippet.gap: worth adding; needs a picker over existing snippets

shopware.openReferences.gap: declared in supportedCommands so the lenses render; Zed cannot execute it

shopware.symfony.runConsoleCommand.gap: a task runs bin/console directly; only the picker is missing
